title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Is a Full 3D Remake Launching February 16, 2027
description: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United launches February 16, 2027 as a full 3D remake with eight protagonists, Freeform Scenario choices and a new timeline battle system.
image_alt: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United key art featuring its ensemble cast beneath the remake logo.
quick_read: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United launches February 16, 2027.
Square Enix describes it as a full 3D remake of the 1995 JRPG.
Eight protagonists, more than twenty recruitable allies and the Freeform Scenario System return.
The remake adds a timeline-based battle system, United Attacks, three difficulty settings and original or rearranged music options.

content_blocks.heading: Eight protagonists, more than twenty allies
Choice still decides the shape of the adventure
The battle timeline changes the rhythm
A classic score, rebuilt two ways
Destinies United is rebuilding the game, not its identity
